title: Shahringizda nima borligini aytish
can_do: Joyda nima borligini va nima yo'qligini ayta olasiz
why: Shaharni, uyni, xonani tasvirlash — sayohatda va yangi joyda eng kerakli ko'nikma. Bu qolip o'zbek tilida umuman boshqacha ishlaydi.

points.text: Joyda biror narsa borligini aytish uchun gap there bilan boshlanadi. So'zma-so'z tarjima qilinmaydi: «There is a park» — «Park bor», «U yerda park bor» emas.

examples.en: There is a park near my house.

points.text: Birlik bilan there is, ko'plik bilan there are. Tanlash keyingi otga qarab qilinadi.

examples.en: There is a bank in this street.
There are two banks in this street.

points.text: Inkor: there isn't / there aren't. Ko'plikda «any» qo'shiladi: There aren't any shops.

examples.en: There isn't a bus stop here.
There aren't any cafés near here.

points.text: Savol: Is there ...? / Are there ...? Qisqa javob — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.

examples.en: 'Is there a pharmacy near here?' 'Yes, there is.'

common_errors.wrong: In my city is a big park.
common_errors.right: There is a big park in my city.
common_errors.why: Bu qolipda gap doim there bilan boshlanadi.
«A museum» — birlik, shuning uchun there is.

common_errors.wrong: It is a park near my house.
common_errors.right: There is a park near my house.
common_errors.why: «It is» aniq narsani tasvirlaydi, mavjudligini bildirmaydi.

common_errors.wrong: Have a bank in this street?
common_errors.right: Is there a bank in this street?
common_errors.why: Joyda nima borligini so'rashda have emas, there is ishlatiladi.

words.example: There is a park near my house.
Is there a bank near here?
Is there a pharmacy near here?
There isn't a bus stop here.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: there is yoki there are ni tanlash
darak gapni savol va inkorga aylantirish
«In my city is», «There is two» xatolarini topish
o'z shahringizda nima borligi haqida gap tuzish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Bu yaqinda dorixona bormi?», «Bu yerda kafe yo'q»

final.task: Mehmon kelmoqchi. Mahallangizda nima borligini yozing: do'kon, bekat, park. 5 gap.

skill_task.task: Odam o'z mahallasini tasvirlaydi. Qaysi joylar bor va qaysilari yo'qligini yozing.
